caption: The drawing depicts a hooked rug design featuring a single brown horse with a black mane and tail standing on a ground patch that has subtle green and blue highlights. The horse is positioned in profile, facing left, and stands inside a fenced area with a picket fence rendered in dark brown and olive green tones. The background behind the fence is a muted beige color, and the entire scene is bordered by a wide, textured-looking border in deep red with black and olive green accents in the corners. The border frames the rectangular composition. Below the drawing, there is handwritten text in pencil reading “J. Glover,” “Westchester County,” “Preliminary (Material) Sketch For Approval of Subject,” and “Hooked Rag Rug (Size 26" x 36") Scale App. 1/3.” The drawing appears to represent the design for a textile piece rather than a traditional drawing or painting.
title: Hooked Rug with Horse
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
